mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as lower rates reduce the discount rate for equity valuations and encourage risk-taking.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day S&P 500 returns remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 6.5% signals economic weakness that reduces corporate earnings expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 6.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of strong labor market growth (PAYEMS) and robust consumer spending (RSAFS) signals a healthy economic expansion, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: doc:Consumer Spending and Labor Market Data
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS growth > 0.5% and RSAFS growth > 1.0%.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL growth > 2.5% annually), the S&P 500 produces negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to anticipated monetary tightening.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL growth > 2.5% annually.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) signals strengthening economic activity, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC between INDPRO and 60-day S&P 500 returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level above 1100 thousand units indicates a robust housing market, which typically leads to increased consumer spending and positive equity market sentiment, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 1100.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP growth rate above 2.0% (GDPC1) indicates robust economic expansion, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 growth > 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: In low interest rate environments (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%), a declining unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and UNRATE decline > 0.2pp.
